evidence.quote: Lakeshore Health Partners prohibits discrimination and harassment in hiring, pay, training and promotion on every ground in the Ontario Human Rights Code
including race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin and creed. This explicitly protects First Nations, Inuit and Métis applicants and employees.

reasoning: Paragraph p3 prohibits discrimination and harassment in hiring, pay, training and promotion on all Ontario Human Rights Code grounds. It names ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin and creed, and explicitly protects First Nations, Inuit and Métis people; no separate equal-opportunity employer statement appears.
